title: Persist Canonical Kit Diff With Backbone Operations
description: Persist structured CanonicalKitDiff as kitDiff on OperationStepDto / SQLite beside kit operation input; wire ChildRuntime createFixedPiece recording; migration for _op_log.kit_diff_json; tests.
summary: Removed KitRecordedStep: Change again stores only Vec<KitOperation>.
